name: Lava Droplets
body:
School transmutation (earth, fire); Level arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 1, bloodrager 1, cleric/oracle/warpriest 1, druid/hunter 1, magus 1, shaman 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Targets up to three pebbles touched
Duration 30 minutes or until discharged
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

EFFECT

This spell functions as magic stone, except the enchanted pebbles melt into lava when hitting a target, dealing 1d6+1 points of fire damage each (including the spell’s enhancement bonus).
